summary: P1-A (DB split → spot_preview) and P1-B (Pricing Admin Console) both verified end-to-end. 20/20 backend pytest pass; full Playwright UI walkthrough passes (login gate, all 6 tabs, edit/save/reset/reset-all, audit, calibration, persistence across reload, back-to-SPOT).
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: services/rate_overrides.py correctly mirrors RATE mutations into engine/runner.py ASMP_DEFAULTS via _RATE_TO_ASMP — without this, engine math would silently ignore admin overrides. Verified live: setting incaRate=1000 changed /api/engine/calculate-all output vs baseline.
GOOD: _BASELINE and _ASMP_BASELINE captured at module import via dict()/deepcopy give a true source-of-truth for reset, even after live dicts are mutated.
GOOD: Audit log filters work (category=rate scopes correctly, including 'ALL' reset-all docs; key=incaRate narrows further). Pagination prev/next testids present.

MINOR: review-request prompt referenced GET /api/quotes/drafts but the router is mounted at /api/drafts (quotes router uses /api/quotes/{id} as a catch-all and returned 404 'Quote not found' for the /drafts path — easy to confuse during debugging). Not a bug, just a documentation note.

MINOR (non-blocking): /api/admin/rates/reset-all currently logs ONE reset_all audit doc PLUS one rate_override_reset doc per key. That is the correct trail, but consider whether you want the per-key resets tagged with a 'batch_id' to make 'all resets from this reset-all' filterable as a unit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (every test ID verified, all 6 tabs working, persistence + role gate + back nav all working)

test_credentials: admin@standardprinting.com / spot-admin-2026 (admin); rwalter@standardprinting.com / spot-rich-2026 (estimator) — both working from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Tests autouse a fixture that calls POST /api/admin/rates/reset-all after each test to keep MongoDB clean. No persistent seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full P1 pass complete. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_rates.py covers DB split (drafts/customers/auth.me), role gate (estimator 403, admin 200), CRUD across all 4 categories, invalid-input rejection (gm_tier='abc' → 400), audit log (set/reset/filter-by-cat/filter-by-key/pagination), reset-all, and override→engine integration (calculate-all output changes when incaRate is overridden). Frontend covered via Playwright: 6 tabs (admin-tab-{rate,gm_tier,sell_tier,grade_adder,audit,calibration}), input/save/reset testids, toast text, override count in header, reset-all confirm dialog (Playwright dialog handler auto-accepts), persistence across page reload (incaRate=888 stayed after F5), back-to-SPOT returns to SpotApp.
verified_engine_integration: POST /api/engine/calculate-all returns different result before vs after PUT /api/admin/rates/rate/incaRate with value=1000, confirming _RATE_TO_ASMP key mirror is active. Engine fix described in agent-to-agent note is working as designed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The originally-feared 'rate mutations don't propagate to engine' bug is correctly prevented by _RATE_TO_ASMP mirror in services/rate_overrides.py.
